messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
Memory: one remembered fact per line, with the dates it held and the note that recorded it. An indented "earlier" line is a version of the fact above it that was later corrected.
- [decision] Reindex jobs will page on failure. (since 2025-10-07; source incident-review/INC-2025-023)
- INC-2026-009 was an incident in which the job scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-16. (since 2026-05-19; source incident-review/INC-2026-009)
- The root cause of INC-2025-023 was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk. (since 2025-10-07; source incident-review/INC-2025-023)
- [decision] For anything related to the Ember team, page Oskar. (since 2025-03-31; source standup/ember/2025-03-31)
- [preference] As of 2026-04-08, for anything Atlas team-related this cycle, page Marcus, not Priya Raman. (since 2026-04-08; source standup/atlas/2026-04-08)
  - earlier: [preference] For anything Atlas team-related, page Priya Raman. (held 2026-03-17 to 2026-04-08; source standup/atlas/2026-03-17)
- [constraint] The indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11, and the pin lifts when the full reindex completes. (since 2025-04-22; source standup/cinder/2025-04-22)
- [decision] Marcus took over the Boreal team on-call shift from Lena on 2025-05-07. (since 2025-05-07; source standup/boreal/2025-05-07)
- [constraint] The product catalog deploys on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays. (since 2025-09-03; source standup/cinder/2025-09-03)
  - earlier: [constraint] The product catalog can be released on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception. (held 2025-03-17 to 2025-09-03; source standup/cinder/2025-03-17)
- As of 2026-03-11, Tomasz is back on the on-call rotation for team Dune. (since 2026-03-11; source standup/dune/2026-03-11)
  - earlier: As of 2026-01-16, Tomasz is off the on-call rotation for team Dune. (held 2026-01-16 to 2026-03-11; source standup/dune/2026-01-16)
- Yuki Tanaka is on the Cinder team. (since 2025-01-08; source standup/cinder/2025-01-08)
- INC-2025-011 was a ledger service incident on 2025-05-24. (since 2025-05-30; source incident-review/INC-2025-011)
- Team Dune sits on the fourth floor. (since 2025-07-24; source standup/dune/2025-07-24)
- The Ember team runs its planning on Fridays. (since 2025-07-21; source standup/ember/2025-07-21)
- As of 2025-11-27, Diego is on the Ember team. (since 2025-11-27; source standup/cinder/2025-11-27)
  - earlier: Diego is on the Cinder team. (held 2025-01-08 to 2025-11-27; source standup/cinder/2025-01-08)
- The Boreal team runs its planning on Thursdays. (since 2026-03-20; source standup/boreal/2026-03-20-2)
- The Cinder team runs its planning on Mondays. (since 2026-04-03; source standup/cinder/2026-04-03)
- [decision] As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team and Tomasz is no longer the primary on-call. (since 2025-07-30; source standup/atlas/2025-07-30)
  - earlier: [decision] As of 2025-06-19, Tomasz is the primary on-call for the Atlas team and Priya Raman is no longer the primary on-call. (held 2025-06-19 to 2025-07-30; source standup/atlas/2025-06-19)
- Until 2025-09-23, the reporting service depended on the ledger service for the nightly balance export; it no longer depends on the ledger service. (since 2025-09-23; source standup/dune/2025-09-23)
- The notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01 during INC-2025-004. (since 2025-02-05; source incident-review/INC-2025-004)
- [decision] The Ember team does pairing on every production change. (since 2025-02-06; source standup/ember/2025-02-06-2)

Question: Why do reindex jobs page on failure?

message.content: Because INC-2025-023's root cause was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk.

So the reason is that INC-2025-023 was caused by a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk. The answer should be one short line with just the reason.
